sources.title: GitHub - athsxx/noleak: Content-addressed dataset fingerprints and ...
sources.snippet: Content-addressed dataset IDs and train/eval leakage checks for AI/ML. Published numbers are only as honest as the split behind them. noleak gives every corpus a stable fingerprint (like a Docker image ID) and measures how much of your eval set already appeared in train — exact copies, GPT-3-style word n-grams, and MinHash near-duplicates.
